changes.evidence: In Blade II, Damaskinos's envoys bring Blade in and he is assigned to the Bloodpack team to hunt the Reapers (the record's own step says he 'joins forces with the Bloodpack'). The team is wiped out in the Prague sewers, which the Bloodpack page calls 'the end of the Bloodpack as a group', and Blade goes on alone until the Nightstalkers recruit him in Blade: Trinity. The Marvel Database infobox lists Bloodpack and Nightstalkers as his former affiliations.

owner_calls.question: Blade II opens with Whistler held prisoner and tortured by Eli Damaskinos's vampires until Blade frees and cures him. Should this captivity be a stage?
options: [["Independent", "Blade: The Series"], ["The Vampire Nation", "Blade II"], ["Independent", "Blade II"]]
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database: after Frost's men bite him in Blade, he is 'kidnapped by the vampires working for Eli Damaskinos... Kept as a prisoner and tortured regularly, Whistler was just recently saved by Blade'. He is freed in the opening of Blade II. The Nightstalkers page lists him only as an ally, so Blade: Trinity needs no new stage.

owner_calls.question: Matt Murdock's record gets a Resistance stage for Deadpool & Wolverine from a name-check alone. Frank's record has the same kind of D&W step (Gambit names the Punisher among the Resistance dead) but no Resistance stage. Should Frank get one, or should the D&W step be dropped from his record?
options: Drop the D&W step: the Void Punisher is not this Frank
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database files the Void Punisher as Francis Castle (Earth-TRN872), 'a Variant of Punisher from an unspecified reality' who joined the Resistance. Deadpool's line 'Which Punisher? There's been, like, five of 'em' leaves open which one it is. Daredevil, by contrast, is filed under Earth-701306.

owner_calls.question: Jen works in Reno's marijuana-growing operation on Oahu, and it falls apart in the title: Reno tries to murder her and Karnak, then Tua's traffickers kill Reno. Should that crew be a stage?
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki: 'Jen was recruited along with Ted by Reno to build a marijuana dealing business'. Reno turns on them after Karnak arrives, she flees the camp wounded, and after Gorgon rescues her she leaves to find the police. No group by this name exists in the data yet.

owner_calls.question: Mordis and Flora capture Sammy and hold him at the Declan Research Facility Lab as bait for Black Bolt, until Karnak and Gorgon free him in episode 6. Before that he went to Declan's lab of his own accord. Should either of these be a stage?
options: Add a captive stage under Maximus's Royal Guard, then Independent, all within Inhumans
owner_calls.evidence: MCU wiki sections 'Declan's Lab' and 'New Captivity': he is 'strapped to a chair and guarded by the Attilan Royal Guard', then released by Karnak and Gorgon and leaves.

owner_calls.question: Longshot quits Mojo's show (episode 24) and in episode 36 goes home 'to continue leading the rebellion against Mojo'. Should leading the rebellion be a group stage?
options: [["Independent", "X-Men: The Animated Series"], ["Mojo's rebellion", "X-Men: The Animated Series"]]
owner_calls.evidence: Marvel Database: 'Longshot quit his own hit TV show, leaving Mojo to kidnap the X-Men' (the quit happens before the episode's main plot, so Mojo's show is backstory, not a stage). Later 'Longshot returned home to continue leading the rebellion against Mojo'. The rebellion is never shown as a named team, and the data has no group for it.
